name: vidmuse
description: Create and recut motion films, direct private VidMuse visual systems, operate media, and manage assets. Routes existing speaking footage to vidmuse-recut, source-free films to vidmuse-create, visual direction to vidmuse-design, semantic asset work to vidmuse-assets, and standalone media operations to media-use.

interface.shortDescription: Route · Recut · Create · Private design · Media · Assets
interface.longDescription: VidMuse routes by the requested deliverable: existing speaking-footage films to /vidmuse-recut, films whose primary material must be made to /vidmuse-create, private visual direction to /vidmuse-design, semantic asset work to /vidmuse-assets, and standalone transcription, alignment, voice, generation, or media transforms to /media-use. Film workflows retain ownership while capability skills execute one layer. Review films on the multi-track VidMuse Timeline.
